name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches the 'if ... also take the key' condition, Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) and Existence(target_picked_up) match 'then pick up the box' after that condition, and Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) gives the required key-before-box order. The compiler's redundancy note on the RespondedExistence is a stated 'if' rule, so it stays.

texts: If the agent moves the ball (blocker_moved), it must also take the key at some point (has_door_key), before, with, or after moving the ball.
If the agent moves the ball (blocker_moved), it must then pick up the box in the other room (target_picked_up) at or after that step.
The agent must pick up the box in the other room (target_picked_up).
The agent must have the key (has_door_key) before it picks up the box (target_picked_up).
